statement: Every finite subgroup of the full once-punctured-torus loop-outer group has one of twelve abstract types: 1, C2, C3, C4, V4, C6, S3, D8, C12, D12, Dic12=C3 semidirect C4 by inversion, or D24. Nine types are realized by the exact D50 free-group maps and the displayed integral D12 action on the punctured torus. Occurrence of C12, Dic12, and D24 remains unresolved. Every S3, D12, or D24 subgroup has the global reflection multiplier. A Dic12 order-four generator has global multiplier square one, positive two-coordinate and negative three-coordinate; the corresponding C12 generator has positive coordinates at both two and three.
depends_on: D33 exact primary homology injections and total order bound; D43 global signs of torus involutions; D50 full two-subgroup classification and character; the explicit Q2 and Q3 matrix-normalizer and norm calculations in the proof
manuscript_passages: Section 30, folios 194-196, scans 383-387; Section 31, folios 198-199 verso, scans 391-394; Part D(b), full loop-outer finite actions in type (1,1)
depends_on_doubtful_reading: None. The proof retains the actual kernel of the two-adic homology map, either 1 or C3. Three-adic faithfulness is used only on an actual subgroup of order three, and all semidirect products are identified by displayed maps.
notes: Four Sylow three-subgroups in a finite two-adic image would give A4, S4, or a central double cover whose normal Sylow two-subgroup is D8. The scalar minus identity in a faithful Klein four image and the order-eight automorphism group of D8 exclude these cases. The normal C3 therefore gives the exact Q2(zeta3) field normalizer. In the kernel-C3 case, the Q3(zeta3) normalizer has determinant equal to the inversion character; the full minimum-valuation proof excludes norm minus one. D50 then forces the V4 and D8 complement actions, yielding D12 and D24. The executed code checks all displayed finite multiplication maps, twelve integral torus matrices, 121 norm-matrix identities, 72 three-adic unit-residue cases, and the eight D8 automorphisms. This is an allowed abstract list with nine actual realizations, not a conjugacy classification or an existence assertion for the three extra types.
